description: Get one tool's profile when the user asks about a specific tool ('what does Cursor cost', 'does Bolt have a free plan', 'what's Lovable bad at'). Input: `id` from search/recommend results (e.g. 'cursor'); optional `fields` (summary, description, best_for, not_for, skill, coding, pricing, platforms, strengths, weaknesses, alternatives, video, compare, official, all). Default returns summary, who it's best for, lowest paid price and plan text, free tier text, 2 strengths, 2 weaknesses, go link (tracked link to the official site) and the VCP page URL to cite.
name: fetch
title: Get tool details
